subject: Trial bridge grant & pricing makeup request
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sparrowlytics.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@sparrowlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial bridge grant & pricing makeup request

Hi Lena — great demo yesterday, thanks again for the time. Based on our conversation it sounds like Sparrowlytics is ready to validate a small production flow but needs two short things to hit proof-of-value for the ML team: a 30-day extension on the hosted trial and a modest token grant to cover peak evaluation traffic (~150k tokens).

We ran the usage profile against our serving profiles and I attached a short MAAP (minimum achievable acceptance profile) and a draft deal summary so you can share with procurement. High level ask: 30-day trial extension + 150k token bridge credit, and a temporary promo rate for month 1 to bridge usage while model tuning stabilizes.

Why this helps Sparrowlytics and Redwood: the ML team needs deterministic latency at ~200 qps for a short window; extending the trial plus a small credit lets them run their edge cases without committing to a reserved pool yet and gives us the data to recommend a Dedicated sizing.

Can procurement or your legal team confirm what purchase order path you prefer? If needed, I can escalate an exec-level concession to my manager for approval — just flag if the token grant or promo requires an exception.

Attachments: Sparrowlytics_MAAP_v1.pdf, SPW-2026-041_deal_summary.xlsx

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial bridge grant & pricing makeup request — need exec exception?

Team — forwarding Sparrowlytics' request. Short summary: prospect asks for 30-day hosted trial extension + 150k token bridge credit. Their usage is ~70% generation, 30% embeddings during the trial window. They are evaluating for a mid-market deployment; likely a 12–18 month commit if POC succeeds. I attached the MAAP and a 1-pager deal summary.

Why I recommend we consider a one-time promotional bridge for this account: Sparrowlytics is in late-stage evaluation with clear timeline to commit if the ML metrics pass; the credit is small ($X equivalent) relative to expected annual revenue and reduces friction to get them into Dedicated sizing recommendations.

Requested asks for approval:
- 30-day trial extension (hosted)
- 150k token grant (apply first to generation tokens, remaining to embeddings)
- Temporary promo rate: 20% off standard hosted generation rate for month 1 (to help them stabilize)

Notes: procurement wants an addendum; finance will require an internal approval code for the credit. I believe this falls under promo concession but requires exec signoff because of the combined token + price concession.

Attachments: Sparrowlytics_MAAP_v1.pdf, SPW-2026-041_deal_summary.xlsx

Can someone from sales ops/finance confirm the $ impact and greenlight? If yes, Aditya — can you authorize the concession per our delegated thresholds?

Thanks,
Mateo

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sparrowlytics.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@sparrowlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial bridge grant & pricing makeup request — need exec exception?

Quick calc and recommendation — I pulled the usage telemetry and modeled expected revenue if they convert to a Small Dedicated pool within 90 days.

Summary:
- Proposed token credit: 150,000 tokens (~$900 list value at current hosted rates; generation-heavy)
- Proposed promo: 20% off hosted generation rate for month 1 (~$1,200 revenue reduction at expected consumption)
- Net expected ARR uplift if converted to Dedicated: $85k–$120k depending on sizing

Recommendation: Approve the credit and the month-1 promo as a combined concession, but tie approval to a conditional PO/addendum and a 90-day mutual action plan (MAP) that includes a technical checkpoint and a go/no-go for Dedicated sizing. Add a clawback: if they do not move to a committed solution within 120 days, the promo is rescinded (we can convert remaining credits to a one-time invoice).

This stays within Marissa's delegated discount bands but because token credit + price promo are combined, we'd need Aditya or somebody in leadership to ack the exception for accounting. Finance will also want a GL code for the credit consumption.

If approved, I'll prepare the concession memo (finance + legal) and the HubSpot entry.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks all for the clear context. I reviewed Ben's numbers and the MAAP. Approve the following one-time concession for Sparrowlytics (SPW-2026-041):

- 30-day hosted trial extension
- 150,000 token bridge credit (apply to generation first, then embeddings)
- 20% promo off hosted generation rate for month 1

Conditions:
1) Procurement provides a signed PO or addendum within 14 days that references deal_id SPW-2026-041.
2) Mateo to capture a MAP with technical checkpoints (90 days) and a conversion-goal for Dedicated sizing. If conversion does not occur within 120 days, finance to invoice any unused credit at list value.
3) Ben to submit concession memo for accounting with GL code and expected revenue impact.

Ben/Marissa — please draft the concession memo and I will sign the executive exception form. Mateo — coordinate contract addendum and confirm once PO received.

Aditya Rao
